summary: Iteration 9 tested 2 new features — (1) Recap Auto Post on ended trips and (2) Facebook Login config gating. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter9_features.py — 8/8 pytest cases PASS in 5.4s. Covers: ended-trip GET /api/trips/{id} triggers one system message with kind='recap', name='Travelo', user_id=null, data.recap_token == trip.share_token; trip doc gets recap_auto_posted=True + share_token; cross-user idempotency (3x aarav GETs + 2x meera GETs never add a second system message or dup notifications — both aarav and meera receive exactly ONE recap_ready notif each with data.trip_id set); non-ended trips (future end_date and today's end_date) do NOT auto-post (strict <today check verified); public GET /api/recap/{token} returns recap payload without auth; Facebook gating — /api/auth/facebook/status → {configured:false}, /api/auth/facebook/login → 400 with 'Facebook login isn't configured yet' message, /api/auth/facebook/callback?code=x&state=y → 302 Location: /auth?fb_error=1; regression: both test users log in via email/password successfully. Frontend Playwright (login as aarav→open fixture trip 6a6b799a06a3b3002fbd8e43→Chat tab): trip-chat-system-message rendered exactly once, centered card with teal bg rgb(11,79,108); chat-recap-link href='/recap/efc6VHgvHCo' target='_blank' verified; NO reaction chips inside the system message container; recap slideshow at /recap/efc6VHgvHCo loads with recap-next-btn present. AuthPage: auth-facebook-btn is disabled=true, auth-google-btn is NOT disabled, helper text 'Facebook login activates once you add your Meta OAuth credentials' visible. Regression: email login worked for both aarav@test.com and meera@test.com (session cookie set, redirect to /dashboard). Meera's /api/notifications includes 2 recap_ready notifications (1 from fixture trip + 1 from TEST_Iter9_Ended_A created here — confirms new registered-member notification path). Zero console errors during full flow.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers_trips.py maybe_post_recap: today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%d') and end_date >= today uses UTC date. Trips ending on 'today' in a user's local timezone that is already 'tomorrow' UTC will auto-post 24h early (and vice versa). Consider deriving the cutoff using the trip's timezone/organizer locale, or at least document that end_date is compared against UTC calendar day.

backend/routers_trips.py maybe_post_recap: the atomic-claim update sets recap_auto_posted=True BEFORE share_token/system-message/notifications are written. If insert_one on trip_messages or notify() raises, the trip is locked as 'posted' but has no system message — no self-heal. Wrap the post-claim writes in try/except and roll back recap_auto_posted on failure, or ensure share_token is written first so recap_sweep() can retry the message insert.

backend/routers_trips.py maybe_post_recap: notifications loop only fires for members with a user_id set (line 659). Invited-but-unregistered members (email-only) silently miss the notification even after they later register with that email. Consider queueing a pending 'recap_ready' when the invited email later joins, or backfilling on member.link.

backend/auth.py facebook_callback: on success path also uses public_origin(request) but sets state cookie with path='/' — good; however on the /callback failure branch the RedirectResponse does NOT clear the fb_oauth_state cookie. A stale state cookie can linger up to 10 min and confuse subsequent login attempts once keys are configured. Add resp.delete_cookie('fb_oauth_state') on the fail redirect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (FB button disabled + helper text + Google unaffected, aarav+meera email login, system message rendered once with recap link opening slideshow in new tab, no reactions on system message, no console errors)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created 4 TEST_Iter9_* trips (Ended_A, Future, TodayEnds, Ended_B) via /api/trips POST — all deleted via DELETE /api/trips/{id} in module teardown. Fixture trip TEST_Ended Goa Blast (6a6b799a06a3b3002fbd8e43) left intact per instructions. Meera picked up an extra recap_ready notification during backend Ended_A test — cleaned automatically when trip was deleted (notifications reference deleted trip id but are harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recap auto-post is idempotent and works cross-user on lazy GET; recap_sweep_loop was NOT explicitly exercised (deterministic path is the GET trigger, which is what UI hits anyway). Facebook keys are still absent in backend/.env — status=false. If keys are later added, test_facebook_status_unconfigured and test_facebook_login_400 will need to be inverted. Fixture trip's recap token is 'efc6VHgvHCo'. TripCreate model requires body.members (list of {name,email}) and body.budget_total — not member_emails. Chat tab in TripDetails is reachable via get_by_role('tab', name='Chat').
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects. Recap auto-post correctly uses atomic $ne:True claim to guarantee single insert; system message renders with data.recap_token; notifications fan out to all members with user_id. Facebook flow correctly gated by fb_config() env check with 400 on /login and 302→/auth?fb_error=1 on /callback.
